title: The Blood Lust Warrior
author: Zorkfire Games
description:
Welcome to the fantastic world of the Blood Lust warrior, an RPG written in inform 7.
You play the roll of a young trainee of master Jonasar.
After he catches you reading his book of ancient legends, you embark on a quest to find the blood lust warrior, a fabled barbarian.
Little do you know, you will run into such things as a witch, a gem-thieving rodent and a treasure-stealing goblin.
